nodes.help: Fake dialogue: per line one sine tone per character (1/15 s each, 24 kHz mono), then its pause_s of silence; cues per line; one progress step per line. No line fails `<node>: nothing to say`.

nodes.title: Encode
nodes.help: Encodes the prompt (and its beats, as one prompt) for video and audio with Gemma 4 and the connector; the text encoder is unloaded before sampling.

params.name: beats
params.label: Prompt beats

seconds.label: Length
seconds.help: How long this beat lasts, in seconds; 0 shares what the others leave equally.

params.help: Prompt Relay: each beat steers the picture (not the sound) for its stretch of the clip, in order; the prompt above holds for the whole clip.

nodes.title: Keyframes
nodes.help: Pins gallery images at chosen times of the clip: at 0 s the clip starts from the image, later ones are frames it passes through. Bypassed: text to video.

params.name: images
params.label: Frames

seconds.label: At
seconds.help: Where in the clip, in seconds: 0 is the first frame, the clip's length its last.

strength.label: Strength
strength.help: 1 holds the frame to the image; lower lets the model drift from it.

nodes.title: Sample
nodes.help: Denoises video and audio together. Stage 1 starts from the seed's noise at half size (canvas and duration); stage 2 refines an upscaled latent at full size (latent).

params.name: role
params.label: Stage
params.help: stage1: half size, ancestral sampler, 8 steps. stage2: full size from latent, renoised at 0.909, 3 steps.

params.name: steps
params.label: Steps
params.help: Fixed by the stage's distilled schedule: stage 1 runs 8 steps, stage 2 runs 3 (fewer would stop with noise left in).

nodes.title: Upscale latent
nodes.help: Doubles the video latent's width and height with the spatial upsampler; the audio latent passes through.

nodes.title: Decode
nodes.help: Decodes video and audio and writes an MP4 (H.264 + AAC 48 kHz stereo) with a poster frame; a clip made from source audio carries that audio, trimmed to the clip.

params.name: audio
params.label: Audio
params.help: Off: an MP4 without a sound track. The picture is the same: the model always generates both.

nodes.title: Encode (guided)
nodes.help: Encodes the prompt and the fixed negative prompt for video and audio with Gemma 4 and the connector, for the guided (dev) samplers; the text encoder is unloaded before sampling.

nodes.title: Source video
nodes.help: Encodes a gallery video and its sound with the video and audio VAEs, at its own size and frame rate; its length is floored to 8k + 1 frames.

nodes.title: Source audio
nodes.help: Encodes a stretch of a gallery audio take (or a video's sound) at 16 kHz stereo; the clip lasts as long as that stretch, floored to 8k + 1 frames (at most 321).

params.name: source

params.name: fps
params.label: Frame rate

nodes.title: Retake

params.name: audio

params.name: steps
params.label: Steps
params.help: Euler steps of the guided loop; each runs the model four times over the whole clip.

params.name: cfg
params.label: CFG
params.help: How strongly the prompt is followed against the fixed negative prompt.

params.name: stg
params.label: STG
params.help: Spatio-temporal guidance (block 28 skipped); 0 turns it off.

nodes.title: Extend

nodes.title: MiniMax H3 Image
nodes.help: The weights to load.

params.name: variant
params.label: Variant
params.help: fp8: smaller community weights, NVIDIA hosts only.

params.name: precision
params.label: Precision
params.help: Base: stored bf16, always quantized to int8 at load (bf16 is 66 GB per model); its float32 tensors and the VAE stay float32. Base fp8: fp8, as stored.

nodes.help: Rewrites the prompt with MiniMax's prompt enhancer (27B, thinking on) and picks an aspect for an auto canvas; it sees the references of the encode node its text feeds. Bypassed: the prompt and canvas pass through.

params.name: think
params.label: Think
params.help: Think longer (reasoning effort xhigh instead of low): better prompts, slower.

nodes.title: Encode
nodes.help: Encodes the prompt and up to 16 reference images; with references the run is an edit.

params.name: refs
params.label: References
params.help: Images to edit or combine, in order; the prompt names them <Picture 1>, <Picture 2>, … Alpha is dropped.

nodes.title: Sample
nodes.help: Denoises from the seed's noise in 6 fixed steps (guidance-distilled: no steps, CFG or negative prompt).

params.name: sampler
params.label: Sampler
params.help: Euler repeats exactly with the same seed. LCM re-noises every step from the device's RNG, so it does not repeat on another device.

nodes.title: Decode
nodes.help: Turns the latent into an RGB image with the VAE, always tiled (256 px tiles, as released); under 4 MP resized to the canvas.

nodes.title: Canvas
nodes.help: The video size in pixels: sides multiples of 32 from 256 to 1344, at most 768 × 1344 pixels in all (1,032,192). 864 × 480 is 16:9.

nodes.title: Duration
nodes.help: The clip's length on MiniMax H3's 5 + 17k frame grid at 24 fps: 124 frames is about 5 s, 362 about 15 s.

params.name: fps
params.label: Frame rate
params.help: MiniMax H3 runs at 24 fps.

nodes.title: MiniMax H3
nodes.help: The weights to load: FL2VA for text and frames to video, Ref2VA for references (one folder holds both).

params.name: variant
params.label: Variant
params.help: Base: Macs only. fp8: smaller community weights, NVIDIA hosts only.

params.name: precision
params.label: Precision
params.help: Base: stored bf16; the h3 binary quantizes the transformer to int8 at load on M5 (other Macs keep bf16). Base fp8: fp8, as stored.

nodes.title: Generate
nodes.help: Runs MiniMax H3 end to end in its own process (the native h3 binary): encodes the prompt and any frames or references, denoises, decodes picture and sound, and writes an MP4 (H.264 + AAC 32 kHz, 24 fps). References use the Ref2VA model, everything else FL2VA.

params.name: steps
params.label: Steps
params.help: Denoising passes: 50 is the reference quality, 4 to 7 a fast draft.

params.name: speed
params.label: Speed
params.help: exact: all 50 transformer blocks every step. fast: 45 blocks and every other step reused: quicker, slightly different.

params.name: refs
params.label: References
params.help: Images the prompt names <Picture 1>, <Picture 2>, …; any reference (image, video or audio) switches to the Ref2VA model and cannot go with a first or last frame.

params.name: videos
params.label: Video references

video.label: Video
video.help: A video take; in and out pick the part it reads (2 to 15 s).

sound.label: Sound
sound.help: keep: the model also hears the video's sound (a take without sound is read silent). silent: picture only.

params.help: Videos the prompt names <Video 1>, <Video 2>, <Video 3>: 2 to 15 s each, 15 s in all.

params.name: audios
params.label: Audio references

audio.label: Audio
audio.help: An audio take, or a video's sound; in and out pick the part it reads (2 to 15 s).

params.help: Sounds the prompt names <Audio 1>, <Audio 2>, <Audio 3>: 2 to 15 s each, 15 s in all; needs an image or video reference too.
